correctness.rationale: For a two-seat committee W, a violating group exists for a candidate c if and only if the entire unrepresented part of c's support has size at least n/(2h_c), including equality. If a top pair (a,b) violates, choose any such witness with s supporters in that unrepresented part. At least one voter supports a, so s<=n-1 and h_c>=tau=n/[2(n-1)]. The witness group has at least n/2 members, all of whom approve c. These voters and at least one supporter of a outside the group make (a,c) represent a strict majority, even when n is even and h_c=1. So (a,c) is rJR. With alpha=h_a>=beta=h_b and alpha<=1, the price is at most (alpha+beta)/(alpha+h_c)<=2alpha/(alpha+tau)<=2/(1+tau). The three-candidate profile with one voter for both unit candidates and n-1 for the tau candidate attains the price, including n=2; subtracting it from 4/3 gives 4/[3(3n-2)]. At equality for n>=3 every top pair violates, and the inequality chain forces beta=alpha=1 and h_c=tau, whence s=n-1. The remaining voter approves both top candidates, and may or may not approve c. The source has a minor mislabeling of which step forces which equality, not a logical gap. I inspected checker.cpp and VERIFICATION.md, not running the submitted code. An independent exact replay at /workspace/branches/two_seat_replay.py directly compared group and supporter criteria on 96,875 exhaustive grid profiles, 400 sampled profiles and nine exact sharpness examples (n=2 through 10) and checked the necessary conditions at sampled equality. One tested n=3 example adds a 7/8-quality candidate supported by the same bloc as the 3/4 candidate; it preserves the geometry but raises the best rJR fraction to 15/16. Finite checks do not establish the universal result.

originality.rationale: The exact price is the reciprocal of the rJR part of the distinct frozen record ecfe633c0898 on the identical domain. The equality geometry is not stated there as a conclusion, but is a direct equality-case reading of its stronger constructive inequality for any optimal pair and any violating witness. Its equations (lines 27–41) have h_c>=tau and the nonnegative slack (1-tau)(alpha-beta)+2tau(1-beta). Extremality forces that slack and h_c-tau to vanish; for n>=3 this forces both top qualities to be one, and the budget equality then forces s=n-1. No materially independent theorem remains after the comparison. This assesses equivalent coverage, not priority between the same-day records.

value.rationale: The exact fixed-n frontier is a meaningful refinement of a limiting guarantee, but taking its reciprocal adds no independent information. The described geometry simply records which inequalities must be tight in the already available constructive bound; it neither adds an independent obstruction nor classifies sufficiency among more general profiles. There is no substantively distinct remainder to repair here.
